name: Takahiro Takamori
source:
A self-proclaimed Hero of Justice, Takataka (as most people call him) is a high-energy chuunibyou. Despite his lack of powers, his love of anime, manga, and light novels has convinced him that he has the makings of a protagonist, and he works hard to achieve that goal. And it has brought with it some results, as his serious training regimen has made him rather swole. In the end, he comes off as more of a goofy big brother, as he tends to get along with children. 

Takataka is quite the bookworm and is smarter than Mizuki when it comes to their studies, getting the third highest grades in the group, only behind Iori and Nerisu. He has a thing for big breasted onee-sans, influenced by his older sister. 

He is needlessly optimistic, and is often compared to Nerisu due to their cheery attitudes, but he’s more of a straight man than she is. He’s not as awkward as her around certain types of people, as well. He works multiple part-time jobs, needed to be done so that he can make a living out of sustaining the Takamori household with his sister.
